newsitem.title: UK: UK shares ease after record setting rally.
newsitem.headline: UK shares ease after record setting rally.

text.p: The UK's leading blue chip index suffered its first setback in more than a week, ending moderately lower on Wednesday as investors took profits.
Having surged 137 points, or 3.2 percent, to record peaks during the previous six sessions, the FTSE 100 share index settled 21.8 points lower at 4,422.5, near the day's worst levels at 4,419.2.
The Dow, also slipping from record levels, was off about 8.5 points as London markets closed, contributing the drop in UK shares, dealers said.
